task.timestamp: Simulation time of the sample, in milliseconds since the start of the simulation.
task.task_id: Identifier of the task within the simulation.
task.task_name: Name of the task as given in the workload trace.
host.timestamp: Simulation time of the sample, in milliseconds since the start of the simulation.
host.host_id: Identifier of the host within the run; `meta/host.parquet` maps it to the host's name and cluster.
task.host_id: Identifier of the host the task last ran on, or null if it has not been placed yet.
powerSource.power_source_id: Identifier of the power source within the run; `meta/powerSource.parquet` maps it to its name and data center.
battery.battery_id: Identifier of the battery within the run; `meta/battery.parquet` maps it to its name and data center.
service.timestamp: Simulation time of the sample, in milliseconds since the start of the simulation.
task.schedule_time: Last time the task was placed on a host, or null if it has never been placed.
task.finish_time: Last time the task completed, failed or was terminated, or null if none of these happened yet.
